name: thanks-hero
description: Demo thank-you hero: success tick, heading, gradient subheading and paragraph on the colour-wash backdrop, then the inline Cal.com booking calendar. Live: #ap-demo-thank-you on the seven 2026 demo thank-you pages (/thank-you-fire/, /thank-you-police/, the K-12 / Higher Ed / Local Government / Public Works pages, /thank-you-schedule-demo/) and the restyled hero of /thanks-guided-trial-pro/ (variant trial).

title.description: Main heading, e.g. Thank you! Line breaks are kept.

title_tag.description: Heading level of the main heading. The demo pages use h1; /thanks-guided-trial-pro/ marks it up as h2.

subtitle.description: Gradient line under the heading (an h2), e.g. Let’s get your walkthrough booked.

body.description: Paragraph under the subheading. Wrap a run in **double asterisks** to bold it.

background.description: Backdrop image URL (the soft colour wash), drawn cover-sized behind the whole section.

cal_link.description: Cal.com booking link (path after app.cal.com/). Empty hides the calendar.

cal_namespace.description: Cal.com embed namespace (lower-case letters, digits, hyphens). Booking events are posted under it, which the site's GTM listener reads.

variant.description: demo: the seven demo thank-you pages. trial: /thanks-guided-trial-pro/ — smaller two-line heading, wider copy column, no bottom padding under the calendar.
